description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Auxio (org.oxycblt.auxio), version 4.1.5.

features.name: Browse the music library by songs
features.description: Browse the music library by songs as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap the Songs tab in the home screen
tap a song to start playback

features.name: Browse by album
features.description: Browse by album as documented for Auxio.
actions: scroll or use the fast-scroll index
tap an album to open its detail page with the track list

features.name: Browse by artist
features.description: Browse by artist as documented for Auxio.
actions: review their albums and songs on the artist detail page

features.name: Browse by genre
features.description: Browse by genre as documented for Auxio.
actions: review the artists, albums and songs in it

features.name: Browse by playlist
features.description: Browse by playlist as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap a playlist to open it
tap a track to play it from that playlist

features.name: Play a song
features.description: Play a song as documented for Auxio.
actions: Tap any song in a list
playback begins and the bottom playback bar appears
tap the bar to expand the full player

features.name: Control playback from the expanded player
features.description: Control playback from the expanded player as documented for Auxio.
actions: Tap the playback bar to expand it
use play/pause, previous, next and the seek bar
tap the cover art or swipe down to collapse it

features.name: Use repeat and shuffle
features.description: Use repeat and shuffle as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap the repeat icon to cycle through off, repeat all and repeat one
tap the shuffle icon to toggle shuffled playback

features.name: Shuffle the whole library
features.description: Shuffle the whole library as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap the shuffle action in the toolbar (or the shuffle floating button)
the entire library is queued in random order

features.name: View and edit the play queue
features.description: View and edit the play queue as documented for Auxio.
actions: drag the handle beside an item to reorder it
swipe an item away to remove it

features.name: Add a song, album or artist to the queue
features.description: Add a song, album or artist to the queue as documented for Auxio.
actions: Long-press the item (or tap its overflow menu)
tap "Play next" to insert it after the current track, or "Add to queue" to append it

features.name: Create a playlist
features.description: Create a playlist as documented for Auxio.

features.name: Add songs to an existing playlist
features.description: Add songs to an existing playlist as documented for Auxio.
actions: Long-press a song, album, artist or genre
select the target playlist (or create a new one)

features.name: Rename, reorder or delete a playlist
features.description: Rename, reorder or delete a playlist as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap Rename and enter the new name, tap the edit action to drag the tracks into a new order, or tap Delete and confirm

features.name: Import a playlist from an M3U file
features.description: Import a playlist from an M3U file as documented for Auxio.
actions: confirm; the referenced songs are matched against the library

features.name: Export a playlist to an M3U file
features.description: Export a playlist to an M3U file as documented for Auxio.
actions: choose the destination and the path format

features.name: Search the library
features.description: Search the library as documented for Auxio.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
filter the results by type using the chips
tap a result to play or open it

features.name: Sort a list
features.description: Sort a list as documented for Auxio.
actions: Open any library tab or detail page
tap the sort icon in the toolbar
choose the sort field (for example name, artist, album, year, duration, date added or track number)

features.name: View song details and file information
features.description: View song details and file information as documented for Auxio.
actions: read the title, artist, album, track number, disc, year, genre, format, bitrate, sample rate and file path

features.name: Jump from a song to its album or artist
features.description: Jump from a song to its album or artist as documented for Auxio.
actions: Long-press a song (or open the player overflow menu)
tap "Go to album" or "Go to artist"

features.name: Share a song
features.description: Share a song as documented for Auxio.
actions: choose the destination app in the Android share sheet

features.name: Configure which folders are scanned
features.description: Configure which folders are scanned as documented for Auxio.
actions: add folders to the include or exclude list
tap the rescan action to rebuild the library

features.name: Rescan the music library
features.description: Rescan the music library as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap the "Rescan music library" action (or pull down to refresh on the home screen)
wait for the indexing notification to finish

features.name: Configure how multi-value tags are separated
features.description: Configure how multi-value tags are separated as documented for Auxio.
actions: select the characters (for example comma, semicolon, slash, plus, ampersand) used to split artist and genre tags

features.name: Enable or disable ReplayGain
features.description: Enable or disable ReplayGain as documented for Auxio.
actions: choose the mode (off, track, album, or dynamic)
optionally set the pre-amp values for tracks with and without ReplayGain data

features.name: Open the system equaliser
features.description: Open the system equaliser as documented for Auxio.
actions: tap the equaliser entry (or the equaliser action in the player overflow menu)
the system audio effects panel opens

features.name: Configure headset and audio focus behaviour
features.description: Configure headset and audio focus behaviour as documented for Auxio.
actions: toggle whether playback resumes when headphones are plugged in, whether playback pauses on focus loss and whether playback pauses when a song is repeated

features.name: Choose what the playback bar and notification show
features.description: Choose what the playback bar and notification show as documented for Auxio.
actions: set the cover art behaviour, the round-mode option and the information shown in the notification

features.name: Change the theme and accent colour
features.description: Change the theme and accent colour as documented for Auxio.
actions: enable the black theme for dark mode
select the accent colour or enable Material You dynamic colours

features.name: Choose which library tabs are visible and their order
features.description: Choose which library tabs are visible and their order as documented for Auxio.
actions: tick the tabs to show (Songs, Albums, Artists, Genres, Playlists)
drag them into the required order

features.name: Set the playback behaviour when selecting a song
features.description: Set the playback behaviour when selecting a song as documented for Auxio.
actions: choose whether tapping a song plays from the whole library, the current list, the album or the artist

features.name: Add the Auxio home screen widget
features.description: Add the Auxio home screen widget as documented for Auxio.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the widget onto the home screen
resize it to reveal the additional controls

features.name: Save and restore the playback state
features.description: Save and restore the playback state as documented for Auxio.
actions: use the "Save playback state" and "Restore playback state"/wipe actions in the playback section
confirm; the queue and position are stored so playback resumes after a restart

features.name: View the about screen and licences
features.description: View the about screen and licences as documented for Auxio.
actions: read the version, the song/album/artist counts, the source link and the open-source licences
